request.report:
Verified the completed M1 spec-replay item and confirmed every acceptance criterion is met.

Measured on private :8089 (production command, port swapped, 4 fresh-server phases each: single-agent, single-mem, dual-agent, dual-mem):
- bench/spec_replay.py present and committed.
- bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/ holds off-greedy, A-greedy, B-greedy, off-prod, A-prod (best-prod). Each dir has requests.jsonl, vram.txt, 4 server logs, and all 4 phases (scripted check: all OK).
- A/B foreground rows (84 each) all carry draft_n and draft_n_accepted.
- draft_n=0 across all requests occurs only in the off configs; I added a clarifying line to off-greedy/notes.txt and off-prod/notes.txt explaining 0 drafts are expected (speculation off by design) and that the A/B runs prove --mmproj does not block n-gram speculation.
- mmproj outcome stated in bench/m1-notes.md: §3 (source-cited verdict) + final section — text-only spec works with --mmproj loaded (same VRAM ~9507-9508 MiB), image-batch spec unsupported.

Decision: DO NOT DEPLOY. Default ngram-mod regressed both busy two-slot roles (agent fg 26.7 vs off 31.3 tok/s; mem fg 23.4 vs off 25.4 tok/s) and changed outputs. Live bonsai-2-27b entry left unchanged.

Docs: experiment page site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md, updated series site/series/serving/index.md and project site/index.md. Site metadata (required fields, <=200-word summaries, series presence, single project page, no stale parent updated) verified by hand against all tools/check_site.py rules; the PyYAML-dependent script cannot execute in this sandbox (no yaml module, and tools/ is outside the bench/evals run path and is protected).
request.summary: All 3 "Done when" criteria met. (1) Real agent + mem0 replays measured on :8089 with speculation off vs 2 n-gram settings (A default ngram-mod, B short-draft ngram-mod), 1 and 2 slots busy — decode tok/s, draft acceptance, and temp-0 output identity are in bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/*/requests.jsonl and bench/m1-notes.md. (2) Decision: no-deploy, documented in site/index.md, site/series/serving/index.md, site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md, bench/m1-notes.md; live entry unchanged. (3) Experiment page site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md plus updated series (site/series/serving/index.md) and project (site/index.md) summaries; site metadata manually verified against every tools/check_site.py rule (PyYAML unavailable in sandbox).
